_why: Thresholds for scripts/desk_truth_monitor.py (operator 2026-10-22: "fix all of these n8n first for scheduling and monitoring"). Read-only monitors; each check writes its own LaneRunReceipt and queues at most one DIGEST host comms intent (P2) when its finding set GAINS a finding. Tuning a number here is a reviewed config change; nothing here can make a monitor write a store, a stop or a broker.

portfolio_total._note: LQ-1611: the one total the pages publish (PortfolioTotal@v1, scripts/lib/portfolio_total_contract.py). This lane compares portfolio_totals.total_value with the sum of the rows the page publishes; a disagreement beyond tolerance is TOTAL_FIELD_DRIFT and alerts, because the header would otherwise not equal its own rows. broker_market_value_total is reported for the receipt only: the repricer's re-mark is expected between passes, so it never alerts here.

holdings_drift._note: accounts = the positions_current account keys compared (config/portfolio_positions.yaml required_accounts). Holdings freshness = the newest broker_position_as_of_at on those accounts' holdings.json rows (what schwab_position_sync stamps per row), falling back to the document's positions_built_at, which only moves when the position list changes.

options_desk_staleness._note: Desk freshness = the newer of options_proposals.json generated_at (full build, */10 12:00-15:59 ET) and quote_refresh.at (scripts/options_desk_quote_refresh.py, 09:35-11:50 ET). Until the quote-refresh lane runs, the 09:30-12:00 gap is a real finding every trading morning.

render._note: Playwright Home @412 px (design build order 3). Until it lands the render leg reports SKIPPED, which is DEGRADED, never OK: a card that cannot be looked at is not a verified card.

display_truth._note: LQ-20261107-1646 per DESIGN-LQ-20261107-1646-cc-opus-1.md. Truth side: positions_current + stop_last_known (the broker-read lanes write these; this check never calls a broker). A cash row contributes its dollar balance to the book (the card's total is a portfolio total, not a securities sum); include_cash false drops it. Independent mark: the newest Finviz row per held symbol in market_quotes, never yfinance. Displayed side: the since-close snapshot, the overview projection file, and header_market_freshness_health's own receipt for the header/card VIX contract (this check never re-judges that split). A quote older than quote_stale_after_min in session, or a positions snapshot older than positions_stale_after_h, makes the affected comparison NOT_MEASURED: a partial book compared to a full total would differ for the wrong reason. catalog is the closed set of codes this check may emit; a code not listed here fails the tests.

held_exit_coverage._exclude_note: LQ-20261107-2964 lead decision 2026-11-13 09:39 ET: mutual funds cannot carry stop orders, so a held MUTUAL_FUND is not a coverage gap. It is never hidden: an excluded type with a label in not_stop_protectable_labels is listed in the scan, the heartbeat and the Home Orders reading (data_quality) with that label.
held_exit_coverage._note: Held = positions_current non-cash rows with qty > 0 (live accounts). A position is covered when stop_lifecycle (the stop_lifecycle_monitor snapshot) has a row for the same account and symbol whose lifecycle is in working_lifecycles. A position whose positions_current broker_market_value is above $0 and below the policy floor (config/position_count_authority.json min_position_usd, $100; LQ-20261113-3047 A05, DECISIONS-20261111 §Exemptions) is listed in below_value_floor_rows with its threshold, not counted; a missing or $0 value is unpriced and checked, never dust. The old $1,000 min_position_value_usd (2026-10-22) contradicted the policy and is removed. Paper-account stop rows are counted and tagged PAPER; paper positions are not read (no broker read here). exempt: [{"account": "...", "symbol": "...", "reason": "..."}], each a reviewed operator decision.
